title: A record in a model repository's registry
description: DRAFT 0.1.0-draft.6, 2026-11-04. Every file of a run's folder, harness/runs.registry/<stamp>_<experiment>/: the build records, which are the core schema's (execution-record.schema.json, destined for REMARK), and the execution records, one per job, <toolkit>_<member>_<level>.json, which are the core's with a model repository's fields under the namespace sce-wg-1, defined here and nowhere in the core. One schema covers the whole folder, dispatching on `kind`.

SceWg1.description: A model repository's fields for one job of the harness: which toolkit solved which member at which level, and what the organizer's gate said.

toolkit.description: The toolkit's name as harness/toolkits.yaml spells it.

mode.description: The mode of solution, when a toolkit has more than one, such as indshock or markov; proposed with the results schema's mode string.

code_sha256.description: The hash of the adapter's code and the modules it imports, as the runner's fingerprint computes it.

hash.description: The member's canonical hash, which identifies the model.

level.description: The experiment's level name; the adapter's own argument is in the record's arguments.

toolkit_version.description: As the results file reports it, with its commit when it has one.

comparison.description: The job's comparison with its member's reference, as the comparator wrote it: reported, never judged, since a distance from the reference carries no verdict; only the experiment's checks pass or fail.

status.description: computed: every named distance computed; not run: the member pins no reference, or the job wrote no results file; error: the member pins a reference and the comparison could not be computed, the reference not loading, not answering the same question by the model's identity keys, or a quantity not comparable. An error fails the compare command; a distance never does.

reference.description: The reference results file's hash, as the experiment pins it.

report.description: The comparator's report for the job, relative to the record: every distance with the reference's error beside it.

reference_error.description: The reference's own certified error for that quantity, when the experiment states one.

reason.description: Why the comparison was not run or is in error.

core_version.description: The version of the checker, runner and comparator that gated the run.
